values.note: Operator page: RV sites Sunday-Thursday $50 a night, Friday-Saturday $75. 'Each RV Guest will pay $10.00 per day to include the pool and miniature golf'; stays of 4 or more nights include them for up to five guests. CampLife quotes for 2 adults (read 2026-10-21) run higher than the posted rate before tax: one Tuesday night in January 2027 $59.75, one Saturday $85.62, two nights from a Tuesday $116.50 (tax is 6% of the posted rate alone). A 25%-off 50th-anniversary offer was running in October 2026.

fees.source: https://grandvuepark.com/rv-park-camping/ ('RV site pricing is Sun – Thurs $50.00 nightly, Fri – Sat $75.00 nightly.'; 'Each RV Guest will pay $10.00 per day to include the pool and miniature golf'; 'Stays 4 or more nights will include pool and miniature golf (seasonal), for a maximum of 5 guests.') + CampLife park 1389 estimates, read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://grandvuepark.com/rv-park-camping/ ('We have 40 full hook-up sites that includes both 30 and/or 50-amp electric service, sewage, and water.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All back-in, 50 ft for the RV (Site 23 is 38 ft) plus a 12-ft space for a towed vehicle. One camper per site.

sites.source: https://grandvuepark.com/rv-park-camping/ ('All spots are back-in spaces with 50 feet for the RV (except Site 23, which is 38 feet). Another 12-foot space is provided for a towed vehicle') + rules PDF ('RV sites are permitted to have one camper.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two bath houses (one from December 1 to April 1); General Store in Flurry's Ice Cream & Sweets. Wi-Fi is listed as an RV site amenity on CampLife.

facilities.source: https://grandvuepark.com/rv-park-camping/ ('The campground area includes two brand new bath houses'; 'our General Store, located within Flurry's Ice Cream & Sweets') + CampLife park 1389 site type 'RV Site' amenities (30-Amp, 50-Amp, Full Hook Up, Sewer, Water, Wi-Fi), read 2026-10-21

values.note: December 1 - April 1 only one bathhouse is open and a minimal number of sites are rented.

season.source: https://grandvuepark.com/rv-park-camping/ ('December 1 – April 1 there will only be 1 bathhouse available and a minimal number of sites to rent.') + CampLife selling RV sites for January 2027, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked online through CampLife ('BOOK YOUR SPOT'); within 24 hours of arrival CampLife says 'Please call (304) 845-9810 to reserve within 24 hours.' One-night Saturday stays sold online (January and June 2027). Maximum 14 days at a campsite with at least 7 days between reservations. Cancellation more than 30 days out refunded less $25; no refunds or credits for holiday or special-event weekends.

booking.source: https://grandvuepark.com/rv-park-camping/ + https://grandvuepark.com/wp-content/uploads/Campsite-Contract-rules-and-regulations-2026.pdf ('Maximum duration of stay is 14 days at a campsite, with at minimum 7 days break in between reservations at the campsite.') + CampLife park 1389 availability, read 2026-10-21

note: Marshall County Park & Recreation Board park near Moundsville, on the former par-3 golf course. Ridge-top setting overlooking the Ohio Valley - not on water. The RV section sits away from the pool and activities. On the Fall Festival and Car Show Saturdays (2026: September 26 and October 10) no driving through the area is permitted. --Claude
summary: Operator page, rules PDF and CampLife: fees $50 weekday / $75 weekend added (+$10/guest/day pool & mini-golf under 4 nights); 50-amp full hookups and 40 back-in sites confirmed, max_rig 50 added (the note's 65-ft pads was wrong); year-round with minimal winter sites; 14-night max; camp store, Wi-Fi. Note cleaned of structured facts and the wrong 65-ft figure.
